Scene: a broad empty coastal Los Angeles boulevard at sunset, rows of tall palms, low Art Deco storefronts along both edges, distant hazy hills, peach and coral sky transitioning to lavender, amber sun spilling from the upper right, soft long road shadows. Visual reference brief: the user's reference photos show pink sunset on a palm-lined beach promenade and a warm orange Vinewood boulevard receding into the horizon. Invent a fresh environment and composition inspired by those details. Keep the center third quiet and darker for a centered sign-in card; concentrate tall palms, storefronts, an unbranded parked dark sports car and strong scenic detail in the left and right outer thirds. Landscape dominates, no foreground people. Rich visible scenery behind a dark website overlay. No words, no shop lettering, no game logos, no interface, no watermark, no frame, no collage.
